description: This file contains the main activity class for an Android app that demonstrates spell checking. It manages the spell checker session, queries suggestions, and handles callbacks to display suggestions for text input.

classes.name: HelloSpellCheckerActivity
classes.description: Main activity that interacts with Android's spell checker service to perform spell checking and display suggestions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and references the main TextView.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Sets up the spell checker session and requests suggestions based on platform version.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Closes the spell checker session when the activity is paused.

methods.name: dumpSuggestionsInfoInternal
methods.description: Formats suggestions data for display in the UI.

methods.name: onGetSuggestions
methods.description: Callback that handles and displays suggestions for individual text info queries.

methods.name: onGetSentenceSuggestions
methods.description: Callback that handles and displays sentence-level suggestions.
